changeSet.author: Tom Peeters
changeSet.comment: Metadata columns for de-identified ("shareable") stubbed runs on the single LADYBUG table: sharable (the report is a PHI-free synthetic copy) and originid (source report id). Required because the global extractors add them to every DatabaseLogStorage insert. NOT shown in the default views — only the Shareable view's own metadataNames surfaces originId. Lowercase to avoid the PostgreSQL quoted-identifier mismatch.
